paper.title_en: Production cross sections of neutron-rich nuclides near the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>126</mn></mrow></math> neutron-shell closure from 1000 MeV/u <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Pb</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>208</mn></mmultiscripts></math> on <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Be</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>9</mn></mmultiscripts></math>
paper.abstract_en: The production cross sections of neutron-rich nuclides near the <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>126</mn></mrow></math> neutron shell closure have been measured for the elements ranging from tungsten (<math><mrow><mi>Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>74</mn></mrow></math>) to gold (<math><mrow><mi>Z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>79</mn><mo>)</mo></mrow></math> in the fragmentation of a <math><mrow><mn>1000</mn><mspace width="0.28em"/><mi>MeV</mi><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">u</mi></mrow><mo> </mo><mmultiscripts><mi>Pb</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>208</mn></mmultiscripts></math> beam on a <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Be</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>9</mn></mmultiscripts></math> target. Several cross sections, namely those for <math><mmultiscripts><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>196</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>199</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mmultiscripts><mi>Re</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>199</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>201</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math>, and <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Os</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>202</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>203</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math>, were determined for the first time with this projectile-target combination. The results are compared with the predictions of several nuclear reaction models and semiempirical parametrizations; special attention is devoted to multiple proton-removal channels and the formation of nuclides with neutron number <math><mrow><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>127</mn></mrow></math>.
